title: bizarre hardcoding of "public" in oracle dialect when reflecting synonyms

labels.name: reflection
labels.description: reflection of tables, columns, constraints, defaults, sequences, views, everything else

labels.name: near-term release
labels.description: addition to the milestone which indicates this should be in a near-term release

body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/discussions/9456

the test here "fails" but we want to look at the generated SQL for each case:

```py
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, MetaData, Table, event

e = create_engine("oracle://scott:tiger@oracle18c") #, echo='debug')

@event.listens_for(e, "before_cursor_execute")
def before_cursor_execute(conn, cursor, statement, parameters, context,
                                                        executemany):
    if "FROM all_synonyms a_synonyms" in statement:
        print("\n-------------------------\n")
        print(f"{statement}")
        print(f"{parameters}")
        print(f"schema name given as: {parameters['owner_1']}")

with e.begin() as conn:
    metadata = MetaData()

    try:
        Table(
                "v$datafile",
                metadata,
                autoload_with=e,
                oracle_resolve_synonyms=True,
                schema="test_schema"
        )
    except:
        pass

    try:
        Table(
                "v$datafile",
                metadata,
                autoload_with=e,
                oracle_resolve_synonyms=True,
                schema="public"
        )
    except:
        pass

```

output:

```
-------------------------

SELECT a_synonyms.synonym_name, a_synonyms.table_name, a_synonyms.table_owner, a_synonyms.db_link 
FROM all_synonyms a_synonyms 
WHERE a_synonyms.owner = :owner_1 AND a_synonyms.synonym_name IN (:synonym_name_1_1)
{'owner_1': 'TEST_SCHEMA', 'synonym_name_1_1': 'V$DATAFILE'}
schema name given as: TEST_SCHEMA

-------------------------

SELECT a_synonyms.synonym_name, a_synonyms.table_name, a_synonyms.table_owner, a_synonyms.db_link 
FROM all_synonyms a_synonyms 
WHERE a_synonyms.owner = :owner_1 AND a_synonyms.synonym_name IN (:synonym_name_1_1)
{'owner_1': 'public', 'synonym_name_1_1': 'V$DATAFILE'}
schema name given as: public

```


**why** is the name "public" not being normalized !?!?!   I'm about to look at the source and be like, "oh right, blah, whatever", just savoring this temporary place of unreality...
